'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Tigray conflict]]
**The [[Tigray People's Liberation Front]] (TPLF) launches rockets at [[Bahir Dar]], capital of [[Ethiopia]]'s [[Amhara Region]], raising fears that the conflict could grow into a wider war. Amhara Region authorities report that the "illegal" TPLF group "launched a rocket attack around 1:40 am" but that the attack caused no damage. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict/ethiopias-tigray-forces-fire-rockets-at-neighbouring-regions-capital-idUSKBN2800FB?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*A sealed copy of the 1990 [[Nintendo Entertainment System]] game [[Super Mario Bros. 3]] sells for {{USD|156,000|2020}}, the most ever paid for a video game. It features rare alternate cover art with the word Bros. on the left instead of the center. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/technology/rare-copy-super-mario-3-sells-156g-auction (Fox Business)]

****[[Canada|Canadian]] [[Conservative Party of Canada|Conservative]] [[House of Commons of Canada|MP]] [[Kelly McCauley]] demands an audit, alleging that more than 800,000 ineligible people received Canada Emergency Response Benefit money from the [[Canada Revenue Agency]]. '''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Navajo Nation]]
******[[Navajo Nation]] reports 351 new infections in the last 24 hours, a new single-day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/arizona/2020/11/20/navajo-nation-hits-record-number-covid-cases-single-day/6367272002/ (''The Arizona Republic'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[Donald Trump Jr.]], son of outgoing [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]], tests positive for COVID-19. His spokesperson says that he is asymptomatic. [https://www.bbc.com/news/election-us-2020-55024888 (BBC News)]
*****[[United States Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[Rick Scott]] of [[Florida]] tests positive for COVID-19. He is expected to continue working from his house in [[Naples, Florida|Naples]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/rick-scott-covid-19-positive/ (CBS News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] reports a record 13,005 new cases in the last 24 hours. In addition, 4,750 people are hospitalized, the first time the state has seen such numbers since August. [https://thehill.com/changing-america/well-being/longevity/526961-california-sets-new-daily-record-for-coronavirus-cases  (''The Hill'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ohio]]
*****[[Ohio]] reports a record 8,808 new cases, bringing the total number of cases in the state to 335,423. [https://www.cleveland19.com/2020/11/20/record-high-coronavirus-cases-reported-ohio-last-hours-additional-tests-pending-review/ (WOIO-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[Newark, New Jersey|Newark]] [[Mayor of Newark|Mayor]] [[Ras Baraka]] issues a ten-day [[Stay-at-home order|stay-at-home]] advisory starting the day before [[Thanksgiving]] on November 25 until December 4. The city also will close streets into [[The Ironbound|Ironbound District]] to non-residents at 8:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m. [[Eastern Time Zone|EST]] in the zip code 07105 on Friday and Saturday to enforce an existing curfew. [https://abc7ny.com/nj-covid-restrictions-new-jersey-coronavirus-alert-johns-hopkins-map/8115436/ (WABC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Utah]]
*****[[Utah]] reports a record 4,588 new cases in the last 24 hours. [https://www.abc4.com/news/cases-surge-utah-reports-record-4588-new-covid-19-cases-friday-17-new-deaths/ (KTVX-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
*****[[Governor of Wisconsin|Governor]] [[Tony Evers]] issues a new public health order that requires people aged five or older to wear a [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|face mask]] when they are indoors or in an enclosed space with anyone outside their household or living unit. The mandate is effective immediately and will expire after 60 days. [https://waow.com/2020/11/20/gov-tony-evers-announces-new-public-health-order/ (WAOW-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[Michigan]] reports 9,779 new cases, a new one-day record. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/health/2020/11/20/michigan-coronavirus-cases-up-to-295177-death-toll-now-at-8377/ (WDIV-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Hampshire]]
*****[[Governor of New Hampshire|New Hampshire Governor]] [[Chris Sununu]] implements a new statewide mask mandate amid rise of cases in the [[New Hampshire|state]]. [https://patch.com/new-hampshire/concord-nh/new-hampshire-implements-mask-face-covering-order-friday (Patch.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Regional Municipality of Peel]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Toronto]]
******[[Ontario]] [[Premier of Ontario|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that [[Toronto]] and the [[Regional Municipality of Peel|Peel Region]] will be placed in a "[[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]]" tier, meaning that most non-essential businesses will be closed and non-essential retail stores and food establishments will be limited to takeout and curbside pick-up or delivery. These new measures will begin on November 23. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/ontario-places-toronto-and-peel-region-under-lockdown-most-non-essential-businesses-will-close-1.5197410 (CFTO-DT)]
*****Ontario surpasses 100,000 total cases of COVID-19. [https://www.cp24.com/news/ontario-reports-1-418-new-covid-19-cases-total-case-count-tops-100-000-1.5197584 (CP24)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Alberta]] reports a record 1,155 new cases in the last 24 hours. In addition, the number of active cases in the province reaches 10,655, the highest number since the pandemic began in March. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/no-new-covid-19-restrictions-as-alberta-reports-a-record-1-155-new-cases-friday-1.5809836 (CBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Community of Madrid]]
*****[[Madrid]] will close its borders with other [[Autonomous communities of Spain|regions]] between December 4 and 14 in an effort to stop the spread of [[COVID-19]] over the December holiday week. [https://english.elpais.com/spanish_news/2020-11-20/madrid-will-close-its-borders-for-10-days-in-early-december.html (''El Pais'' in English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[Germany]] reaches a record high of 23,648, according to the [[Robert Koch Institute]], bringing the nationwide total to 879,564 cases. [https://www.rnd.de/gesundheit/rki-zahlen-aktuell-23648-corona-neuinfektionen-in-deutschland-am-freitag-BMFEKYSAEKTE6YV5PET7GXHS4Y.html (RND)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****The [[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Assembly of the Republic (Portugal)|Assembly of the Republic]] approves a 15-day extension of the [[state of emergency]] beginning November 24 in order to allow a continuation of measures aimed to stop the spread of COVID-19. The current state of emergency will expire on November 23. [https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2020-11-20/new-state-of-emergency-approved-by-the-parliament/56833 (The Portugal News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record 24,318 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total since the beginning of the pandemic to 2,039,926 cases. [https://www.aninews.in/news/world/asia/russia-registers-over-24000-covid-19-cases-in-24-hours-for-1st-time-ever-response-center20201120143439 (ANI)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Sweden]] reports a record of 7,240 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, according to the [[Public Health Agency of Sweden]], bringing the nationwide total since the beginning of the pandemic to 208,295 cases. [https://www.svt.se/nyheter/snabbkollen/66-nya-dodsfall-i-covid-19 (SVT Nyheter)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 141 new deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 12,084. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-announces-5103-more-covid-19-patients-in-last-24-hours/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 14,575 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 598,085. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-in-ukraine-14575-new-cases-229-new-deaths-313163-active-cases.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The number of new confirmed cases in [[South Korea]] reaches a three-month high of 363 cases. The country now has more than 30,000 total cases, according to data from the [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]]. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201120002052320?section=national/national (Yonhap News Agency)]
****In response to a spike in COVID-19 cases, [[Prime Minister of South Korea|Prime Minister]] [[Chung Sye-kyun]] asks people to avoid year-end social gatherings and only leave their house for essential reasons. [http://world.kbs.co.kr/service/news_view.htm?lang=e&Seq_Code=157737 (KBS World)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Secretary for Food and Health]] [[Sophia Chan]] announces the suspension of classes for students in Grades one to three in primary schools for two weeks beginning November 23 due to an increase in new COVID-19 cases in [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/4/159289/Junior-primary-classes-suspended-for-two-weeks (''The Standard'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] surpasses nine million total cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], becoming the second country in the world to reach that milestone after the [[United States]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/indias-covid-count-hits-9-million-rise-slowest-since-1st/articleshow/79312302.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] reports a record of more than 2,400 new cases, according to official figures. It comes as many prefectures such as [[Osaka Prefecture|Osaka]] and [[Hokkaido Prefecture|Hokkaido]] report record numbers of new cases, prompting governors across the country to raise the alarm. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20201120_38/ (NHK World)] [https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj2020112000757/ (Nippon.com)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****[[State of Palestine|Palestine]] reports a record 1,472 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 81,294. [https://www.al-monitor.com/pulse/originals/2020/11/palestine-highest-ever-daily-covid-19-coronavirus-cases.html#ixzz6eN5xWQV0 (Al-Monitor)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[South Australia]]n [[Premier of South Australia|Premier]] [[Steven Marshall]] announces an immediate easing of restrictions surrounding exercise, with further restrictions to be eased by the end of the week, blaming the state's brief hard lockdown on an infected individual who lied to contact tracers. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/sa-covid-restrictions-to-ease-on-saturday-including-gyms-pubs-exercise-and-schools-c-1617236 (7 News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] surpasses six million total confirmed cases of COVID-19, becoming the third country to do so after [[India]] and the [[United States]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-brazil-tally-idUKKBN2802QE (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Pfizer]] and [[BioNTech]] apply for an [[emergency use authorization]] from the U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] for their [[BNT162b2|vaccine]]. If the application is approved, the vaccine will likely be limited and rolled out in phases. [https://www.cnbc.com/2020/11/20/covid-19-vaccine-pfizer-will-apply-for-fda-emergency-use-authorization.html (CNBC)]
*[[Japan]]'s [[Kagawa Prefecture]] will cull 850,000 [[chicken]]s at two [[Poultry farming|poultry farm]]s after the country reported its first [[Avian influenza|bird flu outbreak]] in more than two years. It will be the sixth and seventh cases of avian flu in the prefecture and the biggest culling to be done at once. [https://www.thepoultrysite.com/news/2020/11/japan-to-cull-850-000-chickens-after-bird-flu-outbreak (The Poultry Site)]

'''International relations'''
*[[APEC Malaysia 2020]]
**Leaders from the [[Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation]] host a virtual summit in [[Malaysia]] to seek ways to revive their economies. U.S. [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] participates in the event for the first time since [[APEC Vietnam 2017|2017]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/apec-leaders-including-trump-begin-virtual-meeting-74314488 (ABC News)]

*[[List of mass shootings in the United States in 2020]]
**[[Mayfair Mall shooting]]
***Eight people are injured in a [[mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] at [[Mayfair Mall]] in [[Wauwatosa, Wisconsin]], leading to an emergency response. The shooter remains at large. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/11/20/us/wisconsin-wauwatosa-mayfair-mall-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*The [[Ethiopia]]n Broadcasting Authority suspends the press license for [[Reuters]]'s Ethiopia correspondent, and issues warnings to those representing the [[BBC]] and [[Deutsche Welle]], for their alleged biased coverage of the [[Tigray conflict]].
